message:
The build script builds libdwarf and then compiles the fuzz target. The submit server will build and run the target. I just need to create the PoC input file. Let me create a minimal ELF file with a `.gnu_debuglink` section containing an empty name.

Let me first create a simple ELF file, then add a `.gnu_debuglink` section with an empty name:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /tmp && cat > test.c << 'EOF'
int main() { return 0; }
EOF
gcc -o test_elf test.c && readelf -S test_elf | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
